rejections.name: Maximum voltage
rejections.reason: Spanish prose on the battery's limit, with no label: "rango de voltaje de funcionamiento de 160 VCC a 500 VCC".

rejections.name: Maximum solar input power
rejections.reason: The manual prints 19,200 W only as the AC input the GEN terminal takes, not a solar rating: "a generator or an AC-coupled source (80 A max or 19,200W)" (p16) and "The maximum allowed AC coupling input is 19,200W." (p24).
